This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of bail to the applicant as he has been arrested on 14.04.2023 in connection with Crime No.34/2023 registered at Police Station Kurwai District Vidisha (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Section 363, 366,
376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
Prosecution case, in brief, is that on 28.01.2023 applicant kidnapped / abducted minor prosecutrix aged about 17 years and 9 months and committed rape upon her repeatedly.

sentences.text: she herself stated in her statement recorded during investigation under Section 164 of CrPC that her date of birth has wrongly been mentioned as 05.05.2005 while her age is about 18-19 years.
She specifically stated that she voluntarily went with the applicant and the applicant did not commit any crime with her.
No offence is made out against the applicant.
Even then, he is in custody since 14.04.2023 and Trial will take time to conclude, therefore, the applicant may be enlarged on bail.
Learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the application and submits that the prosecutrix was minor at the time of incident, therefore, he should not be enlarged on bail.
Heard the learned counsel for both the parties.

Having considered the rival submissions, material pointed out by the learned counsel for the applicant, statement of the prosecutrix with regard to her age and allegations alleged against the applicant, so also the over all facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting anything on merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Trial Court during the pendency of trial.
It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C.
This application is allowed and stands disposed of.
Certified copy as per Rules.
